parsed.rationale: The cluster surfaces one canonical type-alias declaration in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/PlaybackReason.swift` (package `Playback`) plus three separate extension files — `PlaybackReason.swift` (line 40, same file/package), `PlaybackReason+PlayerHeaderView.swift` (package `PlayerHeaderView`), and `PlaybackReason+App.swift` (package `app:iOS`). This is the standard Swift pattern of defining a type once and extending it in each consuming module to add module-specific conformances or helpers. The extensions are intentionally scattered across package boundaries; collapsing them would violate module encapsulation and couple `PlayerHeaderView` and `app:iOS` to each other unnecessarily.
